minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, November 15, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, November 15, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Rafaela Giles Jenny Jolly, Edward
  Padgett.

  Members Absent: Bette Donovan and Scott Snider.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Community Services Specialist.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, October
  18, 2023 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Jen Sancen from Aging Next. Located at 141 Spring Street, in
  Claremont. Jen spoke about the various resources available to seniors. The
  Companions program is seniors helping seniors. “Companions are active senior’s
  living on a fixed income that assist homebound living seniors in their own homes.”
  Another program is the Memory Care Center. “The Aging Next Memory Care center
  serves as a safe, loving environment for older adults with memory impairment.”
  Other programs include the Aging Next Village, Transportation, and opportunities
  for volunteering may be found at www.agingnext.org.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 31 participants per week
  in October.

  Meals on Wheels: 720 meals served to 46 La Verne recipients in October.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of Ocotpber was
  $105.25. The average attendance for October was 49 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $6,448.54

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for Ocotober. The senior program fee
  will be raised to $1.00 after the first of the year.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall session for Mt. SAC has begun.

8. Aging Next: No report.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center, bid approved. La Verne won the contest for
  Perk your Park and will receive $75,000. Still working on bids.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Wednesday, November 22nd – Thanksgiving Luncheon, 9:30AM-12:00PM.
  - Saturday, December 2nd – Holiday Stroll at Mainiero Square in Downtown La
  Verne, 3:00PM-6:00PM.
  - Monday, December 4th– Christmas Tree Lighting, 6:00PM.
  - Wednesday, December 6th – Senior Seminar: Digital Health Literacy Training,
  Presented by Painted Brain in Collaboration with Tri-City Help@Hand.
  - Thursday, December 7th – Excursion, Fashion Island and Rogers Gardens,
  2:00PM-8:30PM.
  - Tuesday, December 12th – Senior Holiday Luncheon, La Verne Community Center,
  10:30AM.
  - Thursday, January 4th – Excursion, Ronald Reagan Presidential Library and Muesum
  featuring Auschwitz and Christmas Around the World, 8:15AM-5:00PM.
  - Friday, January 5th – Senior Seminar: Weight Management, Presented by Optum
  Health and Enhancement Team, 9:30AM.
  - Tuesday, January 23rd – Excursion, USS Iowa Battleship Tour and Seal Beach Pier,
  8:15AM-5:15PM.

11. Public Comments: Tuesday Bible Study group would like to sing Christmas music at
  the Senior Holiday Luncheon and Tuesday, December 12th.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00AM.
  Motion carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, January 17th, 2024 at
  10:00AM.
